final_message.text: Updated `workspace/inventory/pricing.py`, `workspace/inventory/export.py`, and `workspace/inventory/report.py` to support the documented price formats and half-up discount rounding, CSV escaping, and low-stock filtering and sorting. The test suite passes: **6 passed**.

checks.detail: RULE: add tests/test_regressions.py with one test function per bug you fixed (at least 3); the file must pass.
